summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K announcing the appointment of Christophe Van de Weyer as Head of Business Area Global Communications Platform and CEO of Vonage, replacing Niklas Heuveldop who steps down on August 15, 2026. Heuveldop remains available through year-end for transition support. The change is described as orderly and well-prepared, following a restructuring at Vonage. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a routine management succession for a board-level executive. What to watch: clarity on the strategic direction of Vonage under new leadership and any further restructuring.
